props.label: A Manchester cleaning company built on trust
props.heading: Making cleanliness a lifestyle.
paragraphs: We started Cleaniq Services with one simple belief: you should be able to trust the people who clean your space. In cleaning, trust isn't a nice extra. It's everything. You're letting us into your home, your rental or your business, around the things that matter to you. So everything we do is about earning that trust, and then keeping it. We're a local team, based at 20 Swan St in Ancoats, and we clean right across Manchester and Greater Manchester.

It starts with who we send. Our cleaners are vetted, DBS-checked and fully insured, and they bring precision cleaning and genuine care to every job. They notice the little things: the dust on the skirting boards behind the sofa, the limescale around the taps, the oven nobody else wants to touch. We don't rush and we don't cut corners. We look after your place the way we'd want our own looked after.

Every customer is different, so every clean is too. Busy families book a [regular house cleaner](/service/regular-house-cleaning-manchester) to get their evenings back. Tenants rely on our [end of tenancy cleaning](/service/end-of-tenancy-cleaning-manchester) to hand the keys back with confidence. Airbnb hosts trust our [turnover cleans](/service/airbnb-cleaning-manchester) to keep their reviews high, landlords book a [deep clean](/service/deep-cleaning-manchester) between tenancies, and businesses count on our [office cleaning](/service/office-cleaning-manchester) to make the right first impression.

Whatever the job, you get the same standard: careful, thorough and backed by our free 48-hour re-clean guarantee. If we've missed something, just tell us and we'll come back and sort it. No fuss, no extra cost. That's how we're making cleanliness a lifestyle, one trusted clean at a time.
props.missionText: To be the cleaning company Manchester trusts. We want every customer to hand us their keys without a second thought, and come home to a space that feels properly looked after.

props.label: Why trust Cleaniq
props.heading: Why you can trust our cleaners in Manchester.
props.text: Anyone can say they're trustworthy. We'd rather show you. Here's what every Cleaniq Services customer gets, every single time.

cards.title: Vetted, DBS-checked cleaners
cards.text: Every cleaner has a face-to-face interview, a DBS check, background checks and a practical skills assessment before they clean for a customer. If we wouldn't let them into our own homes, they don't join the team.

cards.title: We take care of your property
cards.text: Your home, rental, Airbnb or office is treated with respect. Our fully insured cleaners work carefully around your belongings, follow your notes and tell you if they spot anything that needs your attention.

cards.title: 48-hour re-clean guarantee
cards.text: Not happy with any part of your clean? Let us know within 48 hours and we'll put it right. No chasing, no arguments.

cards.title: Free re-clean
cards.text: Re-cleans under our guarantee are completely free. We send a cleaner back to fix it, because the job isn't done until you're happy with it.

cards.title: Discount on your next clean
cards.text: A few days after your clean, we email you an exclusive returning-customer offer: 10% off your next booking. It's our way of saying thanks for trusting us.

cards.title: Professionalism
cards.text: We carry out every task with precision, dedication, and respect for our clients and their spaces.

cards.title: Integrity
cards.text: We honour our word, act transparently, and ensure accountability in all we do.

cards.title: Sustainability
cards.text: We champion eco-friendly products and responsible methods that protect both people and the planet.

cards.title: Excellence
cards.text: We hold ourselves to the highest standards, striving to exceed expectations every time.

cards.title: Trust
cards.text: We earn lasting relationships through reliability, consistency, and genuine care for our clients.

faqs.a: We're a Manchester cleaning company based at 20 Swan St in Ancoats. Our vetted, DBS-checked and fully insured cleaners look after homes, rentals, Airbnbs and offices across Manchester and Greater Manchester.

faqs.q: What makes Cleaniq Services different from other cleaning companies?
faqs.a: Trust. Every cleaner is vetted, DBS-checked and fully insured, every clean follows a checklist, and every clean is backed by our free 48-hour re-clean guarantee. The photos on our website are from our own jobs, not stock images.

faqs.q: Where are Cleaniq Services' cleaners based?
faqs.a: Our cleaners are based across Manchester and Greater Manchester, so there's usually a local cleaner near you — from Manchester City Centre, Salford and Trafford to Stockport, Bolton and Wigan.

faqs.q: Do you have cleaners near me?
faqs.a: We cover Manchester City Centre, Salford, Trafford, Stockport, Didsbury, Chorlton, Bolton, Bury, Oldham, Rochdale, Tameside, Wigan. If you're nearby but not listed, message us on WhatsApp and we'll check.

faqs.q: What cleaning services do you offer?
faqs.a: End of Tenancy Cleaning, Deep Cleaning, Airbnb Cleaning, Office Cleaning, Post-Construction Cleaning, Regular House Cleaning, General Cleaning, Oven Cleaning, Carpet Cleaning. Each service has its own page with prices and what's included.
Yes. Every cleaner has a face-to-face interview, a DBS check, background checks and a practical skills assessment before cleaning for our customers.

faqs.q: Are your cleaners DBS-checked and insured?
faqs.a: Yes. Our cleaners are DBS-checked and fully insured, so you can trust them in your home, rental property or workplace.

faqs.q: Do you offer a discount on my next clean?
faqs.a: Yes. A few days after your clean, we email you a returning-customer offer of 10% off your next booking, valid for that week.

faqs.q: What if I'm not happy with the cleaning?
faqs.a: We offer a 48-hour re-clean guarantee. Tell us within 48 hours and we'll send a cleaner back to put it right, free of charge.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home while the cleaner is there?
faqs.a: No. Many customers leave a key or an entry code. Just add the access details when you book.

faqs.q: Do your cleaners bring their own cleaning products?
faqs.a: You choose. Use your own products, or our cleaners bring eco-friendly cleaning products and equipment for £10 per visit.

faqs.q: Can I book a cleaner for my business?
faqs.a: Yes. We clean offices, restaurants, gyms, communal areas and event spaces. Tell us about your premises on our commercial cleaning form and we'll send you a quote.

faqs.q: Can I get a quote before I book?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our free quote form, message us on WhatsApp or call +44 7846 726428, and we'll help you choose the right clean.

faqs.q: How do I book a cleaner?
faqs.a: Book online in a few steps, message us on WhatsApp (+44 7846 726428), or call +44 7846 726428. We confirm every booking by email.
